overview_markdown:
AstrBot is a Python-based agentic chatbot framework that connects a wide range of IM platforms (QQ, WeChat, Telegram, Discord, and more) to LLM providers through a unified pipeline. It ships with a web dashboard, a plugin marketplace, knowledge base / RAG support, MCP tool integration, and a ChatUI, making it one of the most feature-complete open-source IM bot frameworks available. It explicitly markets itself as an OpenClaw alternative.

Architecturally, AstrBot is built around an event-driven pipeline with pluggable providers (OpenAI, Gemini, local models via vLLM, etc.), a plugin system with a community market, and a Vue-based admin dashboard. Recent commits show heavy investment in cross-platform CI (Windows/macOS/Linux unit tests), i18n parity across seven languages, and plugin market robustness — signs of a mature, well-maintained project.

Compared to OpenClaw, AstrBot is more chatbot-centric: it excels at multi-platform messaging and plugin extensibility, but is heavier to run (Python runtime, ~90MB+ memory) and offers weaker sandboxing guarantees for autonomous shell execution. Its AGPL-3.0 license is also more restrictive for commercial derivatives. For users whose primary need is a self-hosted, multi-channel AI chat assistant with a rich plugin ecosystem, AstrBot is arguably the stronger choice; for a lean local action agent, OpenClaw retains the edge.
